lounges.name: Etihad Business Lounge
lounges.location: Departure Level 3, between Piers C and D; follow the Etihad lounge signs.

accessRules.label: Etihad First
conditions: Confirm your permitted entry time: Etihad lists access from 3.5 hours before departure, but does not clearly explain exceptions for connecting premium passengers.
Confirm overnight transfer access with Etihad; it is not guaranteed even though the lounge opens 24 hours.

accessRules.label: Etihad Business Comfort or Deluxe

lounges.note: Current Terminal A lounge. First and US Preclearance lounges are separate. Etihad Guest status and paid-entry options are not matched yet; spa services may cost extra.

qualityRating.summary: A 2024 Terminal A walkthrough praised varied seating, modern showers and quieter upper-floor areas. The food assessment was limited because the reviewer mainly stopped for coffee; the large layout takes some navigating.

lounges.name: Pearl Lounge
lounges.location: Airside at the beginning of Pier D; follow Pearl Lounge signs from departures.

sources.title: Priority Pass · Pearl Lounge Terminal A
Zayed International Airport · Pearl Lounge facilities and fees

lounges.note: Three-hour Priority Pass visits. Alcohol is unavailable during Ramadan. Floor numbering differs between airport and program listings. The airport lists showers and wellness rooms as paid; confirm whether your membership includes them.

qualityRating.summary: A family connection review found comfortable seating and a good food selection, especially desserts. A confusing layout, limited power outlets and announcements against lying down made it less useful for sustained rest.
